purpose: Establish uncalibrated multiclass predictive and probability quality metrics before fitting any calibration method.

metric_definitions.log_loss: Multiclass cross-entropy computed using normalized probability rows and the fixed class order.
metric_definitions.multiclass_brier_score: Mean over observations of the sum across classes of (predicted_probability - one_hot_target)^2.
metric_definitions.argmax_accuracy: Fraction of observations whose highest-probability class matches the target class.
metric_definitions.mean_max_confidence: Mean of each observation's maximum class probability.

probability_handling.normalization: Metric calculations use normalized copies of the probability matrices to eliminate floating-point row-sum deviations.

limitations: OOF metrics summarize out-of-fold predictions and are intended as a development baseline.
Validation metrics describe the supplied Validation probabilities; interpretation depends on the provenance and eligibility of those observations.
These metrics alone do not establish good calibration. Reliability analysis and calibration error are addressed in subsection 9.2.4.
